title: postgres:18 container fails to start or loses data when the volume is mounted at /var/lib/postgresql/data
symptoms: error mounting "..." to rootfs at "/var/lib/postgresql/data": ... no such file or directory: unknown
The database is empty after the container is recreated even though a volume was mounted
cause: From PostgreSQL 18 the official image sets PGDATA to /var/lib/postgresql/18/docker and declares the volume at /var/lib/postgresql, so a mount at the old data path is not where the server writes.
fix: Mount the volume at /var/lib/postgresql for 18 and later. For existing data, move the files into an 18/docker subfolder after a proper upgrade, or keep the 17 tag until then.
apply:
services:
  db:
    image: postgres:18
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql
affected: Docker Official Image postgres 18 and later (September 2025)
